name: TRAPPIST-1e
tagline: L'anàleg terrestre més dens dels set — la millor opció del sistema per a aigua líquida.
history: TRAPPIST-1e is the favorite. Nearly Earth's size and density — the most rock-like of the seven — it receives almost exactly the starlight Earth gets, so a surviving atmosphere could keep surface water liquid. It is almost certainly tidally locked: permanent day on one hemisphere, permanent night on the other, and any habitable band would hug the twilight between them. Whether the dwarf's flares stripped it bare is the system's defining question — one JWST is actively chasing through its transit shadow.
